reasons: The frozen 40-case manifest was scanned without changing sample IDs or metric mapping.
All sample trees were verified before and after scanning.
The 16-case strong-label metrics and 24-case weak-negative diagnostics are reported separately.
The two UNKNOWN outcomes were reproduced sequentially and explained as stable manifest-format failures.
caveats: Strict macro F1 is 0.4889 on only 16 strong-label cases and must not be generalized as a population estimate.
The 24 weak negatives cannot support accuracy or false-positive-rate claims.
One normal sample was blocked by repeated vendor jailbreak-YARA matches, and one T01 suspicious sample was allowed.
No third-party sample passed the full dynamic eligibility gate, so no third-party dynamic result exists.
next_route: Return to experiment for structured manifest preflight and a separately frozen expansion of eligible normal/safe single-entrypoint dynamic candidates.
